subject: MediCore Analytics — Launch & Stewardship Briefing
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Alexandra Torres <a.torres@medicore.ai>
Cc: David Park <d.park@medicore.ai>, procurement@medicore.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MediCore Analytics — Launch & Stewardship Briefing

Team / Alexandra,

Thanks again to everyone for getting to signed SOW and moving forward. Quick contextual handoff from sales into the CS/implementation team so we can hit the 2/21 target for initial environment readiness. High level:

- Account: MediCore Analytics (RDW-8421)
- ARR: $1.2M (annualized)
- First paid go-live: targeting 2028-03-14 (pilot rolling to full production over 6 weeks)
- Key contacts: Alexandra Torres (Head of Data), David Park (IT procurement)

Attachments included: RDW-8421_SOW_v1.2.pdf (final draft we sent to legal), signature_page_docusign.pdf (DocuSign link below), and a starter onboarding checklist.

Immediate asks for CS/Impl:
1) Please confirm primary owners for onboarding, implementation PM and escalation contact.
2) Confirm kickoff cadence windows next week (we're proposing week of 2/22).
3) Note outstanding technical blockers: customer will provision a VPN tunnel and S3 access (expected by 2/20), they requested KMS/HSM integration for keys.

Suggested internal owners (sales recommendation):
- CSM owner: Karthik Iyer
- Implementation PM: Mina Haddad
- SRE/infra lead: Vivek Kulkarni
- Exec sponsor for escalations: Laura Bennett

Alexandra — copying you so the CS team can introduce themselves and if any dates need to shift.

DocuSign (signature page): https://docusign.net/envelope/0abc123def
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood/deal/8421

I'll remain in the thread to answer contract/pricing follow-ups.

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0194
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alexandra Torres <a.torres@medicore.ai>, David Park <d.park@medicore.ai>, procurement@medicore.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MediCore Analytics — Launch & Stewardship Briefing

Thanks Soojin — and congrats on closing this. Quick responses and a couple of clarifying questions for planning: 

1) Owner confirmation: I can take CSM lead. Mina please confirm PM assignment. Vivek I can loop into infra prep. Laura — flagged for exec oversight.

2) Compliance/retention question: what retention window did Legal agree to in SOW section 4.2? The customer indicated they need a 90-day KV cache retention with explicit deletion on request — I didn't see that captured in v1.2. If not in SOW, we should add a note and capture expected SLA for deletions.

3) Test data window: to validate inference outputs we'll want a sandbox dataset and a 48-hour QA window prior to pilot. Soojin — can we confirm the customer can provide a 10k-row sample dataset by 2/20?

4) Deployment plan: propose kickoff on 2/22 to align internal teams and run through the acceptance criteria checklist (I'll create a short runbook).

Action items I assign for the kickoff prep: 
- Mina: prepare implementation timeline and sprint0 deck (due 2/18)
- Vivek: confirm GPU pool sizing + network requirements (due 2/18)
- Soojin: confirm signature completion and procurement lead info
- Laura: hold an escalation hours window for first 30 days post-go-live

On attachments: I reviewed RDW-8421_SOW_v1.2.pdf and will flag retention language if needed.

Thanks,

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alexandra Torres <a.torres@medicore.ai>, David Park <d.park@medicore.ai>, procurement@medicore.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MediCore Analytics — Launch & Stewardship Briefing

Good morning — I'll own PM responsibilities and will start drafting a sprint0 timeline. Notes below and a couple of asks: 

- PM: Mina Haddad (I)
- CSM: Karthik Iyer
- SRE: Vivek Kulkarni
- Exec sponsor: Laura Bennett

Proposed kickoff: Wednesday, 22 Feb 2028 at 10:00 AM PT (we can move if customer needs different window). Agenda: Introductions, scope review, success metrics, high-level timeline (sprint0 -> pilot -> go-live), immediate blockers and dependencies.

Dependencies / open items for customer: 
- VPN tunnel + S3 IAM role for sample data (targeted delivery: 2028-02-20)
- KMS key provisioning for encryption-in-transit (customer to confirm key owner and KMS ARN)
- Procurement completion (DocuSign envelope in thread)

I've attached a starter onboarding checklist (medicore_onboarding_checklist.xlsx) with milestones and owners. I'll produce a sprint0 slide deck by EOD 2/18.

DocuSign link for signature: https://docusign.net/envelope/0abc123def

On the retention item Karthik raised — legal confirmed we agreed to 90-day KV cache retention with manual deletion request; I'll flag the SOW to ensure the deletion process is documented in the runbook and add an appendix to the SOW if needed.

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.

Attachments: medicore_onboarding_checklist.xlsx

--
Mina Haddad
Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

- DocuSign: procurement will sign today; David is copied.
- Sample data: we can deliver the 10k-row sample dataset and S3 access by 2/19 (ahead of your requested 2/20). I'll send the IAM role ARN and a contact for our security team once procurement completes.
- KMS: our cloud security team will provide the KMS ARN and permissions details by EOD 2/20.

Kickoff on 2/22 at 10:00 AM PT works for us — please share the calendar invite and agenda.

Looking forward to introductions.

Best,
